notes:
### Added

- Lists that own a selection (explorer tree, source-control changes, stash,
  shelf, Git log, compare drawer, search results and manager dialogs) now
  support Up/Down/Home/End keyboard navigation and reveal the moved row.

### Fixed

- The file tree no longer drops top-level entries when a large subtree
  exhausts the 20,000-entry scan budget: siblings are read before descending.
  Folders skipped by that bounded scan now load their children when expanded,
  so expanding a directory always shows its contents.
- Case-only renames (`readme.md` → `README.md`) now retarget open tabs, tab
  titles, the tree selection, reveal requests and the recent-files list. The
  old code canonicalised the vanished path first, which on the default
  case-insensitive macOS filesystem resolves to the *new* name and made the
  rename look like a no-op.
- An IME composition that loses its text surface no longer leaves stale state
  behind: macOS ends the composition without emitting the events egui
  observes, so the next Enter could be swallowed and the old preedit injected
  into another field. The filter now drops the composition as soon as no
  surface asks for IME input.
- Delete confirmations name open buffers with unsaved edits, for single files
  and batch deletes: the trash recovers the file on disk, not the in-memory
  edits, and the tree-delete path had no dirty-buffer guard.
- Locating the active tab no longer wipes the tree's multi-selection (batch
  actions depend on it); the active file gets its own accent marker instead.
- Switching projects or worktrees clears the tree selection, reveal request
  and locate flash: rows are relative to the visible checkout, so a
  carried-over selection could batch-delete same-named files in the wrong
  worktree.
- Release builds keep unwinding. Four background paths isolate panics with
  `catch_unwind` (VT parser, Git jobs, activity probes, updater); `panic =
  "abort"` turned any one of them into a process exit that lost every unsaved
  buffer.
- A VT reset (`RIS`) starts a new cold-scrollback epoch instead of blocking
  new spooling behind the old id watermark and showing pre-reset lines.
- Closing a console sends SIGHUP and gives the process group a short grace
  period before SIGKILL, so login shells can flush their history.
- New File / New Directory now reject path separators like Rename does, and
  renaming a directory no longer adds it to Recent files.
- Shell resolution refuses executables inside the temp directory and states
  exactly what it checks (known login shell by name, executable, not temp).
- The kitty image queue is capped by entry count as well as payload bytes, so
  a flood of tiny images cannot grow it without bound.
- Editor and settings saves use `F_FULLFSYNC` on macOS and fsync the parent
  directory after the rename, so a power loss cannot lose the file that was
  just saved.
- The updater re-hashes the staged artifact immediately before installing it
  and keeps only the two newest `.app` backups.
- Renaming now retargets checkout-relative tree state (selection, multi-select,
  reveal, flash and expanded folders) instead of comparing it with absolute paths.
- Merge/rebase fast-forward and hard reset refuse to overwrite untracked files,
  matching branch checkout.
- Entering an alternate screen no longer discards the main screen's cold
  scrollback; RIS still starts a new epoch.
- A language server that crashes is reconciled again on the next frame even if
  no document changed, while keeping the spawn backoff.
- Quitting waits for in-flight save and Git jobs instead of killing them.
- Checked commits write the index before moving HEAD and roll back on failure;
  merge ref updates stay inside the checkout transaction.
- Watcher-driven tree reloads keep already-expanded folders populated; Expand
  All loads skipped children and Reload from Disk keeps custom ignore patterns.
- Tree root rows can no longer rename or trash the whole project.
- Cmd+F no longer steals keys from modals/menus, and search navigation only
  runs when the search field owns focus.
- Autosave no longer blocks the UI thread on fsync; saves queued while another
  tool changes the same file report a conflict instead of overwriting it.
- Git fingerprinting runs off the UI thread; no-terminal and occluded windows
  no longer wake the event loop every millisecond.
- Dropped projects open through the bounded job pool instead of blocking a
  frame with a full tree/Git/log scan.
- CRLF/ident/LFS files are cleaned before status, diff and hunk-apply compare
  worktree bytes with Git blobs, so touching them no longer shows phantom changes.
- Rebase replays first-parent commits in topological order and cached patches
  carry mode changes into the index.
- Terminal hot and cold search use the same smart-case regex rules, and X10
  mouse coordinates outside the 255-byte range are not sent.
- An unknown OS version no longer bypasses a manifest `min_os` check.

### Security

- LFS pointers now validate the SHA-256 oid and keep object paths inside
  `<gitdir>/lfs/objects`; a crafted pointer can no longer make checkout or
  stash apply read arbitrary local files.
- The updater creates staged artifacts with a random name in a private 0700
  directory using `create_new`/`O_NOFOLLOW`, and hashes and installs the same
  file descriptor; swapping the staged file between verification and install
  can no longer replace the running app.

### Performance

- Find in terminal scans on a worker after a 120 ms input debounce instead of
  walking the whole scrollback on the UI thread for each keystroke (measured
  73 ms at 10k hot + 34k cold rows); superseded scans are cancelled.
- Cold-scrollback rewrites copy the live rows on a worker and swap them in a
  short spool-lock section, so compaction no longer blocks the per-frame
  screen probe (a 260k-line burst previously stalled it up to ~114 ms per
  rewrite). A write rate that outruns the copier still pays one in-place
  rewrite, halved by shedding the oldest cold rows.
- The Git log view caches its filtered commit list, lane layout and author
  list, and compiles a regex filter once instead of once per commit field per
  frame.
- The console activity probe reads the process table in-process
  (`proc_listallpids`/`proc_pidinfo`/`proc_pidpath`) instead of spawning
  `ps -axo …` every two seconds (20–40 ms of kernel time on a busy Mac); an
  occluded window skips the probe entirely.
- Terminal reflow is debounced to one per drag pause: a resize no longer
  rewraps the scrollback and raises SIGWINCH on every frame.
- The PTY wake coalescer delivers its trailing frame from the reader loop
  instead of spawning a thread per 16 ms window.
- LSP document reconciliation runs only when the open document set or a buffer
  revision changes; protocol events still drain every frame.
- Background jobs now use a bounded worker pool with bounded result and
  watcher queues; bursts coalesce instead of creating unbounded threads.
- Compare filtering caches matcher/index per query and generation, and details
  no longer clone large lists every frame.

---

### 新增

- 带选中态的列表（文件树、源代码管理更改、stash、架藏、Git 日志、Compare
  抽屉、搜索结果与管理对话框）现在支持 ↑/↓/Home/End 键盘导航，并自动把
  移动到的行滚入视野。

### 修复

- 文件树不再因为某个大目录耗尽 20,000 条扫描预算而丢失顶层条目：现在先读完
  同级条目再递归子目录；被预算跳过的目录在展开时会按需加载子项，展开即有内容。
- 仅大小写的重命名（`readme.md` → `README.md`）现在会同步打开的标签页、
  标签标题、树选中、定位请求与最近文件。旧代码先 canonicalize 已消失的旧
  路径，而在默认大小写不敏感的 macOS 文件系统上它会解析成*新*名字，使整次
  重命名看起来没有发生。
- 输入法组字在失去文本控件后不再残留状态：macOS 结束组字时不会发出 egui
  能观察到的事件，导致下一次 Enter 被吞掉、旧预编辑文本被注入到别的输入框。
  过滤器现在会在没有任何控件请求输入法时立刻丢弃组字状态。
- 删除确认会列出有未保存修改的已打开文件（单文件与批量删除）：废纸篓能找回
  磁盘文件，但找不回内存里的修改，而树删除路径此前没有任何脏缓冲保护。
- 定位当前标签不再清空文件树的多选（批量操作依赖它），改为给活动文件单独画
  一条强调色标记。
- 切换项目或 worktree 时会清空树选中、定位请求与闪烁提示：树行是相对当前
  checkout 的，残留的选中会让批量删除把同名文件落到错误的 worktree。
- 发布构建恢复 unwind。四个后台路径用 `catch_unwind` 隔离 panic（VT 解析器、
  Git 任务、活动探测、更新器），`panic = "abort"` 会把其中任何一个变成进程
  退出并丢掉全部未保存缓冲。
- VT 复位（`RIS`）现在开启新的冷历史 epoch，不再被旧的 id 水位挡住、也不会继续
  展示复位前的行。
- 关闭控制台时先发 SIGHUP 并给进程组一个短暂宽限期再 SIGKILL，登录 shell 因此
  能正常写回历史。
- 新建文件/目录现在与重命名一致地拒绝路径分隔符；重命名目录不再把目录塞进
  最近文件。
- Shell 解析拒绝临时目录内的可执行文件，并如实说明实际校验项
  （按文件名匹配已知登录 shell、可执行、不在临时目录）。
- kitty 图片队列同时按条目数和像素字节设上限，海量小图不会无界增长。
- 编辑器与设置保存改用 macOS `F_FULLFSYNC`，并在 rename 后 fsync 父目录，
  断电不会再丢掉刚保存的文件。
- 更新器在安装前重新校验暂存产物哈希，并且只保留最新的两个 `.app` 备份。
- 重命名现在按 checkout 相对路径重定向树状态（选中、多选、定位、闪烁与展开
  目录），不再拿相对路径与绝对路径比较。
- merge/rebase 快进与硬重置拒绝覆盖未跟踪文件，行为与分支切换一致。
- 进入备用屏幕不再丢失主屏幕的冷回滚；RIS 仍开启新 epoch。
- LSP server 崩溃后即使文档没有变化，下一帧也会重新 reconcile，同时保留启动退避。
- 退出会等在途的保存与 Git 作业结束，不再直接杀死后台线程。
- 带路径列表的提交先写 index 再移动 HEAD，失败时回滚；merge 的 ref 更新纳入
  checkout 事务。
- watcher 触发的树刷新保留已展开目录的子节点；Expand All 会补载被跳过的目录，
  Reload from Disk 保留自定义 ignore。
- 树的根目录条目不再能重命名或移入废纸篓，避免整个项目被移走。
- ⌘F 不再从模态/菜单抢键，搜索导航只在搜索输入框拥有焦点时生效。
- 自动保存不再在 UI 线程 fsync；排队期间若其他工具改动了同一文件，保存报冲突
  而不是静默覆盖。
- Git 指纹检查移出 UI 线程；无终端或窗口被遮挡时不再每毫秒唤醒事件循环。
- 拖入项目走有界作业池，不再用一次全量树/Git/日志扫描卡住某一帧。
- CRLF/ident/LFS 文件在状态、diff 与 hunk 应用比较前先 clean，单纯 touch 不再
  误报 Modified。
- rebase 按拓扑顺序重放第一父提交，缓存补丁的 mode 变更会写入 index。
- 终端热区与冷区搜索使用相同的 smart-case 正则语义；X10 鼠标坐标超出 255
  字节范围时不再发送错误值。
- 系统版本未知时不再绕过 manifest 的 `min_os` 检查。

### 安全

- LFS 指针现在强制校验 SHA-256 oid，并把对象路径限制在 `<gitdir>/lfs/objects`
  内；构造恶意指针不再能让 checkout 或 stash apply 读取本机任意文件。
- 更新器用随机名在 0700 私有目录中通过 `create_new`/`O_NOFOLLOW` 创建暂存产物，
  校验与安装共用同一个文件描述符；在校验和安装之间替换暂存文件不再能替换正在
  运行的 App。

### 性能

- 终端内查找改为后台线程 + 120ms 输入防抖，不再每次按键在 UI 线程扫描全部
  历史（实测 1 万热行 + 3.4 万冷行时单次 73ms）；被取代的扫描会被取消。
- 冷历史重写（compaction）改为后台线程复制存活行、仅在短临界区内换文件，
  不再阻塞每帧的屏幕探测（26 万行突发输出时旧实现每次重写会卡顿约 114ms）。
  写入速度超过复制速度时仍会做一次原地重写，并先淘汰最旧的一半冷行以减半停顿。
- Git 日志视图缓存过滤后的提交列表、泳道布局与作者列表，正则过滤只编译一次，
  不再每帧对每个提交的每个字段重新编译。
- 控制台活动探测改为进程内读取进程表
  （`proc_listallpids`/`proc_pidinfo`/`proc_pidpath`），不再每两秒 fork/exec
  一次 `ps -axo …`（繁忙机器上单次 20–40ms 内核时间）；窗口被遮挡时跳过探测。
- 终端 reflow 在拖拽期间防抖为“停止后一次”：调整窗口不再每帧重排回滚历史并
  向全屏 TUI 连发 SIGWINCH。
- PTY 唤醒合并的收尾帧由 reader 线程投递，不再每 16ms 窗口创建一个线程。
- LSP 文档同步只在打开文档集合或缓冲区 revision 变化时执行；协议事件仍每帧排空。
- 后台作业改用有界工作池，结果通道与 watcher 队列也有界；突发请求会合并而不是
  无界创建线程。
- Compare 过滤按查询与 generation 缓存匹配器/索引，详情列不再每帧克隆大列表。
